verdict.rationale: The only sign-in-related evidence is a navigation label naming GCKey accounts (ircc-docs-8). Nothing describes how sign-in works, whether it uses credential MFA, or whether an authorized human can complete it remotely without biometric, in-person, or mailed-PIN steps. The 'biometrics' on that same line refers to immigration application biometrics, not sign-in, so it neither supports nor undermines the story.
